text:
ashley: quick async check — data-mesh instrumentation ownership + outstanding deps for token-cost attribution. milestone target = Fri EOD. can owners confirm status and blockers? cc @kevin @olivia :eyes:

kevin: i can take the event-schema rename + mapping. planning to open a PR today. question: do we want the new field to be `token_cost_usd` or `token_cost_cents`? smaller payload if cents, but more math later.

olivia: re: latency breakdowns — infra plugin is ready for `route_latency_ms` (histogram) but we still need the `route` dimension on the emit side. can teams add `route` to their telemetry?

miguel: embedding pipeline will emit `model_variant` and `token_count` in the next deploy. PR: https://git.internal/r/12345 (draft). blocker: logging-team changed the schema for event envelope last week; need a small adaptor.

ashley: noted. @miguel please drop the adaptor stub in your PR so infra can review. kevin — prefer `token_cost_cents` to keep it integer, less float fun downstream.

kevin: ok, will use `token_cost_cents`. sample payload (will include in PR):
```json
{"event": "generation_complete", "token_count": 124, "token_cost_cents": 15, "route": "/api/v1/generate", "model_variant": "redwood-2.1-q4"}
```

olivia: looks good. small ask — include `latency_p95_ms` and `latency_p50_ms` as tags so Console can graph without heavy rollups.

miguel: adaptor note — logging-team suggested we use `envelope.v2` flag. i'll add a simple mapper in the PR and ping infra for compatibility tests. ETA tomorrow AM.

data-qa: happy to run the smoke checklist once the PR is merged. please add the smoke test items to the PR description:
- payload validation for `token_cost_cents`
- route dimension present on each event
- latency fields present and numeric
- sample size >= 50 events per route

ashley: action items: 1) @kevin open PR with samples + schema change (today) 2) @miguel add envelope adaptor + PR link (tomorrow AM) 3) @olivia confirm Console parsers for `latency_*` (today) 4) @data-qa run smoke checklist post-merge. i'll update the tracking sheet: https://docs.internal/s/instrumentation-data-mesh (please add yourself as owner).

infra-bot: canary-ingestion check: PASS — no schema rejects in last 10m :large_green_circle:

kevin: pushing the PR now, will add the smoke checklist and test vectors. proposing canary rollout Tue 09:00 PT.

ashley: perfect. if any blocker, drop a note here or DM. thanks all :pray:
